description: This file defines the RequestforQuotation class and related functions for handling Request for Quotation (RFQ) processes in an ERP system, including validation, email communication, supplier interactions, and document mapping.

classes.name: RequestforQuotation
classes.description: Main class handling RFQ operations including validation, email communication, supplier management, and document mapping.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the RFQ, including duplicate suppliers and supplier list validation.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_supplier
methods.description: Checks for duplicate suppliers in the RFQ.

methods.name: validate_supplier_list
methods.description: Validates each supplier in the RFQ for RFQ restrictions and warnings based on supplier scorecard.

methods.name: update_email_id
methods.description: Updates email IDs for suppliers if missing.

methods.name: validate_email_id
methods.description: Ensures email ID is provided for a supplier row.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions when RFQ is submitted, including status update and sending emails.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions when RFQ is canceled, updating status.

methods.name: get_supplier_email_preview
methods.description: Returns a formatted email preview for a supplier.

methods.name: send_to_supplier
methods.description: Sends RFQ emails to suppliers and manages contact/user creation.

methods.name: get_link
methods.description: Generates URL link for the RFQ.

methods.name: update_supplier_part_no
methods.description: Updates supplier part numbers for items based on supplier.

methods.name: update_supplier_contact
methods.description: Creates or links supplier contact and user accounts.

methods.name: link_supplier_contact
methods.description: Links or creates a contact for the supplier.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Creates a new user account for a supplier.

methods.name: supplier_rfq_mail
methods.description: Prepares and sends RFQ email to suppliers.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for the RFQ document.

methods.name: update_rfq_supplier_status
methods.description: Updates the quote status of suppliers based on received quotations.
